Immune-mediated pansclerotic skin disease; oral ulcers in 4/4 and disabling joint contractures in 3/4. Cytopenias in 3/4 omitted at the four-axis cap.

Lysosomal storage disorder; developmental delay, dysostosis and hepatic storage with ascites each occur in 30-79%. Cataracts and hearing loss, also 30-79%, omitted at cap.

Hereditary essential tremor is a neurologic movement disorder.
Glycosylation disorder with defining skeletal and dental malformations; developmental delay in 6/9. Severe hearing loss in 30-79% omitted at the four-axis cap.
Benign endothelial vascular neoplasm arising in cutaneous blood vessels.
Cerebellar, brainstem and peripheral nerve degeneration. Eye movement abnormalities and dysphagia are neurologic; optic atrophy occurs in fewer than 30%.
Hereditary posterior radial head dislocation with restricted elbow extension and antecubital pterygium.
Lower motor neuron degeneration causes progressive denervation weakness and atrophy; there is no separate primary muscle disease.
Defined by multiple exostoses, type E brachydactyly and dermal atrophy, each reported in 80-99%.
Seborrheic keratosis is a benign cutaneous epithelial lesion, here located on vulvar skin.
Pontocerebellar malformation and intellectual disability define syndrome; visual impairment/myopia and sensorineural hearing impairment each occur in 30-79%.
